The strategy (June 2020) sets targets for 2024: broadband coverage above 90% of the population including all local government districts, broadband expanded to all local government areas and districts, at least 5 Mbps for every public institution including government buildings, and improved government connectivity and online presence. These are targets for areas and public institutions, with no connection of council offices stated; local government authorities are listed as stakeholders.
